title: Addressing function witness bounds
statement: For every positive integer $m$, the addressing function on $m+2^m$ sign coordinates has total influence at most $m+1$. Moreover, every Boolean function on those coordinates that depends on at most $2^{m-1}$ coordinates has relative Hamming distance at least $1/4$ from the addressing function.
hypotheses_covered: the comparison function is a junta on at most $2^{m-1}$ coordinates
